test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which dance is performed by women of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lavani dance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lavani Dance is a** genre of music popular in Maharashtra.**
 
• It's performed by women and is known for its** powerful rhythm.**
 
• **Lavani has contributed significantly to the development of Marathi folk theatre.**
 
• The songs in '**Lavani**' are mostly erotic in sentiment and the **dialogues tend to be pungent in socio-political satire.**
 
• Lavani is danced to the beat of the **'Dholaki', a drum-like instrument.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
